name: Editorial comparison
art: Use two original or authorized comparison images. The showcase archive asset is site/assets/proof-same-model-same-brief.jpg; inspect its provenance before reuse.

properties.label: Equal-space evidence diptych
properties.text: Give two visual treatments equal image space beneath one short shared title, supported by a fine divider, restrained captions and a visible source or context note.

properties.label: Silver sans with mono captions
properties.text: Use silver sans typography for the shared title and restrained tabular monospace for comparison captions.

properties.label: Near-black with blue divider
properties.text: Use a near-black ground, silver text and one thin blue divider, letting the detailed evidence inside the frames provide texture and complexity.

properties.label: Aligned before-and-after evidence
properties.text: Use actual detailed comparison images aligned to the same content, and keep both sides fully visible rather than dimming evidence for an effect.

properties.label: Keyboard-operable comparison reveal
properties.text: Offer a reveal control only when true before and after images exist, and make it keyboard operable; otherwise present the available composite as a static diptych.

properties.label: Qualified comparison claim
properties.text: State whether the material is an archived example or a controlled evaluation, and never claim causal proof without a documented protocol.

properties.label: Inspectable diptych acceptance
properties.text: Keep both sides inspectable on mobile and verify the provenance of the archive asset before reuse.
